pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
Now I’m finally whole,
a quiet light rising in me!!
Spread your wings! Right now!
Right now...

[Verse 1]
Breaking through the darkest moment of my life
My heart bursts open, reaching for the sky
When I take a deep breath
I can feel my wings unfolding!

[Pre-Chorus]
Tear all my fears apart
Now there's only me and the endless sky
I will never fall again!
I'll think of it again!

[Chorus]
I spread my wings endlessly toward the world!
Filling my heart with confidence and holding it close!
I'm flying right now!
Through the clouds, beyond the sky, all the way to the edge of the world!
Higher! Farther! Stronger!
Until the whole world grows smaller beneath my feet!

[Post-Chorus]
Fly up! Fly up! Fly up!
Fly higher without an end!

[Verse 2]
Let all my tears be carried away by the wind
All that's left is light!
Once these wings have opened
They will never fold again!

[Build-up]
The sky is calling! Saying I'm finally ready!
Saying the moment I've been waiting for is here!
Are you ready? This is where it truly begins!

[Final Chorus]
I spread my wings endlessly toward the world!
I'm gonna fly with confidence!
I'm rising up right now!
The entire sky is opening up before me!
Fly up! Fly up! Forever, Fly up!
Fly up! Fly up! Forever, Fly up!
Fly up! I'm gonna fly! I'm gonna fly forever!

[Outro]
Toward the world… endlessly…
Spread my wings… with confidence…
I'm gonna fly!!!
I'm already flying up!!!
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
